rules.duplicate_findings_merged: self-merging by design - one interaction reports every matching category together, not one row per category

rules.label: Indemnification exposure rides inside the general liability cap
rules.notes: informational, not adversarial - the opposite branch of rules 1/2

rules.label: Liability/Indemnification: ambiguous shared-category treatment

rules.label: Uncapped data-breach liability with no cyber insurance
rules.notes: data_breach is the ONLY liability category with a real insurance coverage-type mapping; do not generalize to other categories (e.g. ip_infringement has no matching insurance product)
